label: common_2010_friend_01
text: Hah, looks like the hero’s finally here![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Would you join us,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_botan_01
text: We’re in for an earful, aren’t we.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_rival_01
text: Guess we’ll find out soon enough![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_02
text: No need for concern, you two. I’m not angry in\nthe slightest.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_03
text: I merely called you all here to discuss your fine\nachievements in this year’s Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_04a
text: You shut down the professor’s time machine\nand thus prevented the ancient Pokémon from\r\nrunning rampant across Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_04b
text: You shut down the professor’s time machine and\nthus prevented the Pokémon from the future from\r\nrunning rampant across Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_05
text: Your actions were truly outstanding in every\nregard, and I couldn’t be prouder of you all.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_06
text: Though your decision to enter a strictly off-limits\narea was admittedly...regrettable.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_rival_02
text: Heh. You’ve got us there.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_07
text: However. Since this was necessary to protect\nPaldea and its precious ecosystems, I am willing\r\nto overlook that particular point.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_botan_02
text: Phew... So we’re not getting raked over the coals\nafter all.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_11
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh! Before I forget, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
there’s
something
I
would
like
you
to have.\c
Each of your friends has received one already,
so this one is for you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_08
text: Oh, and about the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Hall of Fame Badge[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] I gave you\na short while ago—that gift is one we bestow only\r\nupon students who achieve truly remarkable feats.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_09
text: I expect you to honor what that badge represents\nby striving always to serve as a model for your\r\nfellow students.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_select_01
text: You can count on me!

label: common_2010_head_select_02
text: I guess I’ll try...

label: common_2010_head_teacher_10a
text: Splendid. Such enthusiasm will surely take you far\nin life.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_10b
text: Oh? Well...I suppose you must be rather worn out\nfrom your recent adventures.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_10
text: And, Master Arven...I was so sorry to hear about\nthe professor. You have my deepest condolences.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_friend_03a
text: Yeah, it was pretty rough when I found out my\nmom had died...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_03b
text: Yeah, it was pretty rough when I found out my\ndad had died...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_04
text: But weirdly enough, my head actually feels\nclear now. For the first time in ages.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_05
text: In the Great Crater, I got to learn a bit about my\nmom’s research and what she was trying to\r\nachieve down there.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_05b
text: In the Great Crater, I got to learn a bit about my\ndad’s research and what he was trying to achieve\r\ndown there.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_06
text: I guess if you’re building something as mind-\nblowing as a time machine, that takes priority\r\nover showering your son with attention, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_07
text: All I know is I’m done feeling like some lost little\nkid. Done. Time to say good-bye and move on.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_friend_08
text: I’m gonna enjoy every last day till graduation\nwith my buds here—and Mabosstiff, ’course![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_11a
text: Well said, Master Arven. You truly are your\nmother’s son.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_11b
text: Well said, Master Arven. You truly are your\nfather’s son.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_12
text:
Of course, I must remind you that you’ve
nowhere near enough credits to graduate.\c
You’ll need to study frantically to catch up, but I
have every expectation of your success.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_13
text: And let us not forget the other good news!\nOur academy has a new Champion![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_14
text:
Though we sadly cannot make your valiant
deeds in the Great Crater known to the public,
your new Champion Rank, at least, should be
celebrated throughout the whole school![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_rival_03
text: Oooh! I know how we should celebrate! We\nshould hold a Pokémon battle contest![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_friend_10
text: Seriously? Could we not?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_botan_03
text: Classic Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_15
text: A Pokémon battle contest, you say...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_16
text: While your own vested interests in such a venture\nare more than apparent, Miss Nemona, I think\r\nit’s a fine idea![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_17
text: But please understand that a large-scale event\nwill be quite beyond us. We’ve many other\r\nschool activities to keep an eye on, after all...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_top_01
text: Pardon my intrusion. I couldn’t help but overhear.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_2010_top_02
text: The Pokémon League will, of course, happily\nlend a hand in organizing this contest.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_rival_04
text: La Primera?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_18
text: Well, well! A most kind offer, Chairwoman Geeta.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_top_03
text: I do everything in my power to nurture young,\nup-and-coming talent.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_04
text: Though that’s not to say only the youth have\npromise when it comes to Pokémon battles.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_05
text: A former Gym Leader... The developer of the\nPokédex app... This academy clearly counts many\r\nskilled Trainers of Pokémon among its staff.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_06
text: As such, my suggestion is as follows...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_07
text: Students AND staff should compete for the title\nof strongest Trainer at the academy![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_rival_05
text: Whoaaa! We’d get to battle the TEACHERS!\nYou’d compete too, right, Primera?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_friend_11
text: Is that even allowed? The chairwoman’s not part\nof the academy, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_botan_04
text: Aaactually, I think she’s the chairwoman of the\nschool board as well as of the Pokémon League...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_friend_12
text: Wait, for real? I mean, I knew she was on another\nlevel, but...wow.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2010_top_08
text: Thank you for the invitation, Champion Nemona.\c\nI would gladly take up your kind offer to compete\nalongside you all, but...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_09
text: I’m afraid my schedule is already packed tight\nwith work that I simply must attend to.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_rival_09
text: Awww! Can’t you free up some time somehow?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_top_10
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well... I suppose I might be able to participate if
Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)] would agree
to
lend
me
a
hand
with
my work...?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_select_03
text: I’d be happy to help!

label: common_2010_select_04
text: Where should I start?

label: common_2010_top_11
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Excellent answer. Much obliged, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_12
text: To get straight to it, I would like you to go out\nand inspect Paldea’s various Gyms in my stead.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_13
text:
Are they fulfilling their duties as beacons of
strength and inspiration for all those aiming
to achieve Champion Rank?\c
Or has their brilliance started to fade?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_14
text: To find this out, I ask that you bring your full\nmight as Champion to bear against each of the\r\nGym Leaders and test their prowess in battle.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_15
text:
They are all Trainers of exceptional talent,
handpicked by me personally.\c
I do not expect you’ll find any cracks in their
armor, but...well. Consider it a formality.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_16
text: This will also provide the perfect stage for your\nfirst appearance as a new Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_top_17
text:
Since all the Gym Leaders will still be expecting
me to carry out the inspection, I imagine they’ll
have mustered their full strength.\c
I daresay they might be more of a challenge than
when you faced them before.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_rival_06
text: You get to have all-out battles with the Gym\nLeaders?! Man, I’m jealous...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_top_18
text: Now then, on to another crucial matter.\c\nI’d like to discuss with Penny here how to patch\nthe weaknesses in our League Point system.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_botan_05
text: Um. But...there’s a bunch of anime I’ve missed\nthat I was just...gonna...binge...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_top_19
text: Thank you in advance for your willing and\neager cooperation.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_botan_06
text: Gah—I mean...I’ll d-do it. I’ll help. Let me help.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_2010_top_20
text: Excellent. We’ll leave you all to it, then. Come\nnow, Penny.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2010_rival_07
text:
This is awesome, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
Show this inspection thing who’s boss so that
La Primera can join our tournament, OK?\c
And enjoy taking another swing at the Gym
gauntlet while you’re at it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_rival_08
text: I’ll take care of filling out the forms and other\nadministrative stuff so the ball gets rolling on the\r\ntournament in the meantime![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2010_head_teacher_19
text:
I say, it’s wonderful to see you all showing such
initiative. You each have a critical role to play.\c
Penny assisting the League, our new Champion
inspecting Gyms, Nemona arranging the event...
Give it your best, everyone![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2010_friend_14
text: Guess my role’s so obvious it goes without\nsaying?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
